build_dqn_atari_network: build a DQN Atari Q-network with a convolutional torso and value head for a given number of actions
build_rainbow_atari_network: build a Rainbow Q-network with noisy linear layers and C51 distributional outputs for Atari
build_iqn_atari_network: build an IQN network with cosine tau embeddings and a DQN torso for quantile regression
build_c51_atari_network: build a C51 distributional Q-network with softmax logits over a support vector for Atari
build_double_dqn_atari_network: build a Double DQN network with shared bias in the final output layer for Atari
